[P1] Preserve error classification and finalization for checkpoint failures

This also runs when an ordinary synchronous step's checkpoint fails with a permanent 400/403: the earlier termination handling throws `CheckpointUnrecoverableExecutionError` into this catch, which now rethrows it instead of returning `FAILED`. The outer catch does not recognize that wrapper, so existing executions now retry permanent failures and can repeat side effects. For a late 503 after a handler rejection, this throw also skips `onInvocationEnd`, including the plugin drain and telemetry flush. Reconcile the checkpoint error before the common classification/finalization path: return `FAILED` for execution errors, and rethrow invocation errors after notifying plugins. Add composed coverage for permanent checkpoint failures and exactly-once invocation-end hooks on late failures.
